buildCommand: npm --prefix prototype run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const out='.next'; if (fs.existsSync(out)) fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('prototype/.next', out, {recursive:true, force:true}); const src=path.join(out,'routes-manifest.json'); const dst=path.join(out,'routes-manifest-deterministic.json'); if (fs.existsSync(src) && !fs.existsSync(dst)) fs.copyFileSync(src,dst); if (!fs.existsSync('.env')) fs.writeFileSync('.env',''); try { if (fs.existsSync('prototype/public')) { if (fs.existsSync('public')) fs.rmSync('public',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('prototype/public','public',{recursive:true,force:true}); } } catch (e) {}"
